name: ScrapingBee
tagline: Fetch any web page, search the web and get Google, Amazon, Walmart and YouTube data as JSON
description: Connect Cline to the ScrapingBee MCP server. 18 tools: fetch any page as text, markdown, HTML or a screenshot (JavaScript rendering, CAPTCHAs and anti-bot blocking handled), extract structured data from a page, and get clean JSON from Google search, Amazon, Walmart, YouTube, ChatGPT and Gemini. Needs a ScrapingBee API key; a free trial key comes with sign-up.
